name: <vendor.plugin-name>
version: <MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH — start at 1.0.0, or 0.x.x if this plugin is still experimental and its contract may change>
architecture: 1.2 — this is the Bonyan architecture version this plugin targets, not the Core package's own version; replace with a real value like 1.2, not this whole placeholder
type: <one of: infrastructure | product | feature | platform | transport>
adapterType: <ONLY if type is infrastructure AND this plugin consumes an adapter, e.g. storage or auth — otherwise delete this entire field. Never set it to null or an empty string; absence means delete the key.>

required: <vendor.other-plugin.service — cannot function without this, leave as [] (empty array, keep the key) if none>
optional: <vendor.other-plugin.service — works with reduced capability without this, leave as [] (empty array, keep the key) if none>

params.name: <paramName>
params.type: <free-form, JSDoc-style: string|number|boolean|EntityType|EntityType[]|... — the architecture defines no fixed type system, just be descriptive and consistent>

config.<settingName>: <defaultValue — leave the whole object as {} (keep the key) if this plugin has no configuration>
